description: Describes the expected fields for the policy-store manifest.json index and the individual policy markdown files. Policy entries or md files which do not follow this schema will not be accepted into the repository.

manifest.description: The top-level manifest.json file: the searchable index of every published policy and the folder maps for apps, industries and bundles.

policies.name: policies
policies.description: Array of policy entries. Each entry holds the search metadata for one published policy and the path to its folder; see policyEntry for the shape of each entry. The full policy body lives in the policy's policy markdown file.

apps.name: apps
apps.description: Map of app slug to the relative path of the app's folder. Each folder includes, at least, a README.md file.

industries.name: industries
industries.description: Map of industry slug to the relative path of the industry's folder. Each folder includes, at least, a README.md file.

bundles.name: bundles
bundles.description: Map of bundle slug to the relative path of the bundle's folder. Each folder includes, at least, a README.md file.

policyEntry.description: The shape of each object in manifest.policies. Carries the search metadata to find a policy, the policyChecksum that pins its body, and the path to its folder; the description and policy body live in the policy markdown file rather than in the manifest.json file.

path.name: path
path.description: The relative path from manifest.json to the policy folder.

tags.name: tags
tags.description: A list of tags associated with the policy.

publishedAt.name: publishedAt
publishedAt.description: The date the policy was published, as an ISO 8601 date (e.g. 2026-06-02).

direction.name: direction
direction.description: Intended use for the policy. One of: egress, ingress.

apps.name: apps
apps.description: A list of applications this policy is designed for.

industries.name: industries
industries.description: An optional list of industries this policy may be useful for.

bundles.name: bundles
bundles.description: An optional list of use-case bundles this policy is a part of.

policyChecksum.name: policyChecksum
policyChecksum.description: Checksum of the policy body, in the form sha256:<hex>. Used to verify the integrity of the policy markdown file; it must equal the SHA-256 of the (trimmed) Rego body.

schemaVersion.name: schemaVersion
schemaVersion.description: The schema version this policy was published with.

minimumGatewayVersion.name: minimumGatewayVersion
minimumGatewayVersion.description: The minimum DTwo Gateway version required to use this policy.

policy.description: An individual policy markdown file: YAML frontmatter holding the policy metadata, followed by the document body which contains the policy itself inside a fenced ```rego block.

tags.name: tags
tags.description: A list of tags associated with the policy.

publishedAt.name: publishedAt
publishedAt.description: The date the policy was published, as an ISO 8601 date (e.g. 2026-06-02).

description.name: description
description.description: A description of what the policy does. This should include the intent of the policy.

direction.name: direction
direction.description: Intended use for the policy. One of: egress, ingress.

apps.name: apps
apps.description: A list of applications this policy is designed for.

industries.name: industries
industries.description: An optional list of industries this policy may be useful for.

bundles.name: bundles
bundles.description: An optional list of use-case bundles this policy is a part of.

schemaVersion.name: schemaVersion
schemaVersion.description: The schema version this policy was published with.

minimumGatewayVersion.name: minimumGatewayVersion
minimumGatewayVersion.description: The minimum DTwo Gateway version required to use this policy.

policy.name: policy
policy.description: The plain-text Rego policy. This is not a frontmatter field; it is the document body inside the fenced ```rego block.
